Return Assignees Endpoint
/api/partner/1.0/{product}/documents/assignees (PUT)
Endpoint authentication
When adopting OAuth 2.0 as an authentication method, the below security requirements are needed in order to trigger this endpoint:
The user must fulfill the below security roles requirements; if he fails to obtain access to all the necessary security roles, an
error 403: Insufficient privileges to execute this request
is returned:
The user must acquire access to at least one of the following security roles; he needs to have access to the security role corresponding to the product included in the URL:
Tax â Access T1 Product
Tax â Access T2 Product
Tax â Access T3 Product
Tax â Access Forms Product
The user must have the following security role in order to modify the partner or the manager  associated to the return:
Contacts - Edit Assignee
This endpoint validates against the userâs
contact security
and
document visibility
. If the user does not have access to the document provided in the request body or the contact associated to this document, an
error 306: Resource not found in the system
is returned.
Endpoint description
Updates the assignee(s) of the returns specified in the request body. The product (T1, T2, T3, TF) must be included in the URL.
Model
{
âassigneesâ: {
âpreparerUserIdâ: 0,
âreviewerUserIdâ: 0,
âpartnerUserIdâ: 0
âmanagerUserIdâ: 0
},
"documents": [
{
"documentId": âstringâ,
âreturnIdsâ: [0]
}
]
}
Properties
preparerUserId:
Optional parameter used to assign a preparer to the return. The value needs to be the ID of an active user in the system, or 0 to set the preparer to None.
reviewerUserId:
Optional parameter used to assign a reviewer to the return. The value needs to be the ID of an active user in the system, or 0 to set the reviewer to None.
partnerUserId:
Optional parameter used to assign a partner to the return. The value needs to be the ID of an active user in the system who is configured as a partner, or 0 to set the partner to None.
managerUserId:
Optional parameter used to assign a manager to the return. The value needs to be the ID of an active user in the system who is configured as a manager, or 0 to set the manager to None.
documentId:
GUID of the document can be retrieved by creating a get request using the
Documents
endpoint.
returnIds:
Array of taxpayerâs ID (0 for main taxpayer, 1 for spouse and 1000+ for dependants).
The user ID to provide to the preparerUserID, reviewerUserID, partnerUserID and managerUserID can be found from the URL of a user accessed via
Settings -> Users
.
It can also be retrieved by creating a request using the Global Fetch Users endpoint.
Examples
Examples of setting 1 assignee for 1 document:
Request URL
https://mysite.cchifirm.ca/taxcan/api/partner/1.0/T1/documents/assignees
Request body
{
"assignees": {
"preparerUserId": 54
},
"documents": [
{
"documentId": "5d08b25f-daaf-4218-83a9-d29edbab4444",
"returnIds": [0]
}
]
}
Response body
{
"errors": []
}
Examples of setting all 4 assignees for several documents:
Request URL
https://mysite.cchifirm.ca/taxcan/api/partner/1.0/T1/documents/assignees
Request body
{
"assignees": {
"preparerUserId": 54,
"reviewerUserId": 0,
"partnerUserId": 54
"managerUserId": 57
},
"documents": [
{
"documentId": "41f3c892-49c3-4c96-9a20-a78f324d9321",
"returnIds": [0, 1, 1000]
}, {
"documentId": "cd3649d1-a885-4fa0-be6c-7a145611892c",
"returnIds": [1]
}
]
}
Response body
{
"errors": []
}
